creator: Claude Code (claude-sonnet-5-5) worker session tien-nghich-2d-29, 2026-11-22
method: create_character_pro_flash (32x32 native, low top-down, custom template, 8 views, 40-colour palette, seed 7) then animate_character v3 per direction. All four facings are separate PixelLab generations; nothing is mirrored. Directions were queued in several calls and appended to the same animation group because the account's 8 job slots were shared with other lanes.
prompt: Small chibi carp fish floating upright in the air, round plump body of soft blue-grey scales with a pale belly, big round eyes, a tail that splits into a forked ribbon of two long thin flowing pale-blue ribbons, small fins. Wisps of mist beneath it. 3/4 top-down, chunky pixel art, 1px dark outline, light from top-left.

idle.action_description: floats in place gently bobbing up and down, the forked ribbon tail sways slowly and the fins flutter; the tail stays split into two ribbons

direction_prompts.south: facing the viewer, floats and bobs gently, the two ribbon tails sway; tail stays forked
direction_prompts.west: facing left, floats and bobs gently, the two ribbon tails sway behind it; tail stays forked
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, floats and bobs gently, the two ribbon tails sway; tail stays forked
direction_prompts.east: facing right, floats and bobs gently, the two ribbon tails sway behind it; tail stays forked

follow.action_description: glides forward through the air with a swimming wave motion of the body, the forked ribbon tail streams behind in two ribbons and the fins flap

direction_prompts.south: glides toward the viewer with a swimming wave, compact and narrow, the two ribbon tails stay behind and above it; tail stays forked
direction_prompts.west: glides to the left with a swimming wave, the two ribbon tails stream behind it to the right; tail stays forked
direction_prompts.north: glides away from the viewer, seen from behind, compact and narrow; tail stays forked
direction_prompts.east: glides to the right with a swimming wave, the two ribbon tails stream low and flat behind it to the left, level with its body, never rising above its head; tail stays forked; the whole fish stays small and low in the frame (second attempt, east only)

east_take1.prompt: glides to the right with a swimming wave, the two ribbon tails stream behind it to the left; tail stays forked
east_take1.why: 5 opaque pixels fell outside the 32x32 canvas (ribbon tip above frames 1-2, mist below frame 3)
